en-US.description: FileList is a command-line utility that generates a CSV file listing the contents of a given directory.
en-US.longDescription:
FileList is a command-line utility that generates a CSV file listing the contents of a given directory. By default, the list includes the file name, size, and path, as well as the last-access, last-modified, and creation dates, etc. 
You can easily import all results to a spreadsheet or database. - Filter the lists by optional criteria such as file name, file extension, time stamps, directory level, file size or file attributes. - FileList can print or export lists of files from a folder or directory tree, including the file metadata. - FileList can be instructed to include any metadata that Windows Explorer supports, such as camera model, artist name or number of pages.
en-US.name: FileList
